recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見多顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富、淡嗜雙色性（amphophilic），圓形偏心核帶明顯單一大核仁，散在淡粉紅纖維狀基質中，符合神經母細胞瘤化療後的節細胞分化（ganglion cell differentiation）。
features: Large cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Round, often eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin and a single prominent nucleolus (ganglion-like cells)
Pale pink fibrillary (neuropil/Schwannian) stroma surrounding the cells
Scattered brown hemosiderin pigment and adjacent residual hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a focus of large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, round eccentric vesicular nuclei, and single prominent nucleoli, consistent with maturing and mature ganglion cells, occasionally binucleated. These cells lie within pale eosinophilic fibrillary stroma with scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages. Residual hematopoietic cells are present at the periphery. Primitive small round blue cells are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma showing ganglion cell differentiation following chemotherapy.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have multilobated nuclei without a single prominent nucleolus, and are CD61/CD42b positive rather than synaptophysin/PHOX2B positive.
Osteoblasts line trabecular surfaces with an eccentric nucleus and a perinuclear hof, and lack neuropil-like stroma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or rhabdomyosarcoma with large cells
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive glands or nests (keratin positive) and rhabdomyoblasts show cross-striations/desmin, unlike ganglion cells in fibrillary stroma.
